name: TrendPulse — Google News & Trends
tagline: Research current Google News and Google Trends demand signals from Cline
description: A Python MCP server for current-news research and search-interest analysis. Discover Google News stories, extract article content, inspect trending terms, compare keyword momentum, analyze interest over time and by region, and explore related queries and topics.

install.notes: Requires uv/uvx. Installs the published mcp-trendpulse 0.2.11 release from PyPI; no API keys are required for the community server.
